title: Fiona Hedgehog's Hug
description: Fiona wants to hug her forest friends, and finds a creative, cozy solution using soft autumn leaves.

scenes.narration: Fiona Hedgehog loved cozy moments. Whenever she saw her forest friends giving warm hugs, her little heart filled with joy.
scenes.visual: A round little hedgehog sitting happily in a golden autumn forest

scenes.narration: However, Fiona was nervous to offer a hug herself. She was afraid her prickly back might poke someone by mistake.
scenes.visual: A hedgehog looking at her spiky back while watching woodland friends hug

scenes.narration: One golden afternoon, crisp autumn leaves fluttered down around her. Fiona watched a soft maple leaf float down to the mossy earth.
scenes.visual: A hedgehog rolling in a big pile of colorful maple leaves

scenes.narration: She picked up several fluffy, golden leaves and wrapped them gently around her back like a plush, cozy winter coat.
scenes.visual: A tiny hedgehog wrapped snugly in a blanket of soft orange autumn leaves

scenes.narration: When a small field mouse walked by, Fiona opened her arms. The mouse cuddled right into the soft leaf coat with a happy cheer.
scenes.visual: A small field mouse hugging a leaf-wrapped hedgehog on soft forest moss

scenes.narration: Fiona cheered softly. She had found a way to share warmth and affection without worrying about her spines at all.
scenes.visual: Two small forest creatures smiling warmly together under a canopy of leaves

scenes.narration: Wrap yourself up snug and warm for sleep tonight. Follow along for more cozy bedtime stories every night.
scenes.visual: A gentle starry night sky over a sleeping autumn forest clearing
